title: ABC Pvt Ltd v. Commissioner of Income Tax
text: The appellant challenges the assessment order passed by the Commissioner of Income Tax under Section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act disallowing a deduction claimed under Section 80C. The Assessing Officer held that the investment made by the assessee in a specified instrument did not qualify for deduction under Section 80C as the payment was made after the due date of filing of return. The Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) upheld the disallowance. The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal reversed the order holding that the investment was made within the extended time. The department filed this appeal. The High Court examines Section 80C and the relevant circulars. It holds that deduction under Section 80C is available if the investment is made before the due date under Section 139(1). The assessment order disallowing the deduction is set aside. The appeal of the Commissioner of Income Tax is dismissed.
